Findings.Question: Q10
Findings.Defect: RunId validation accepts a trailing LF because RUNID_RE ends with a dollar anchor and is evaluated with match. For example, R20000101T000000Z-0001 followed by LF passes the format check. Putting that same malformed string in handoff.DelegationRunId also passes the equality check. No later check rejects it, so otherwise valid in-scope evidence can produce PASS and exit 0. This is acceptance of malformed identity evidence, even though the Scope membership arithmetic itself remains correct.
Findings.Authority: A-2:87 requires evidence ambiguity to fail closed; A-2:120 adopts A-1 Sec.3, whose line 107 requires delegation.RunId to have the RunId format. AUTOMATION_PLAN at bb0d5522 Sec.16.6:552 defines that format. Owner mandate:23-24 requires unambiguous evidence and fail-closed mismatch handling. LIFECYCLE Sec.5 treats an unverified frozen guarantee as REQUIRED.
Findings.Correction: Use a whole-string RunId match, such as RUNID_RE.fullmatch, and add a synthetic behavioral regression with a trailing LF in both identity fields that requires DELEGATION_RUNID_INVALID and nonzero exit. Demonstrate the regression failing against the current verifier and passing after correction. Preserve A-1/A-2; authorize the corrected verifier blob and updated self-test evidence in the next A-n, then review that exact object before use, as A-2:115-116 requires.
